<!-- pr-reviewer: 264e535bee116bd3b8cc3d64a603caf1e6bafaf7 -->
Needs changes before merge

PR: `feat(post): Tormach mill G54.1 P offsets, M4, G74, and compensation` (#4299). Fixes #4228. Fork PR from JSwetz. Safety floor applies: posted G-code.

What looks good
- G54.1 P10..P500 formats, with the post refusing 501 by name (`tormach.cps` L26, L97-104).
- `millSpindleReverse = true`, M4 on a reversed section, M3 on the next operation: the reset on `OperationName` and at endPreamble closes the leak. `spinRev` reset is exact.
- Left-hand tap G74 vs right-hand G84, same trigger as M4, and the `F` word is the pitch-times-rpm already used for G84 (`tormach.cps` L1360-1370, L1426).
- Right-hand output is unchanged: the conformance goldens still pass byte-exact (nc/tormach/).
- Control cutter compensation G41/G42/G40 with the `D` word on linear moves, D registered at the tool number, table from the Fanuc pattern (`tormach.cps` L471-483). Rapids and arcs refuse the engagement by name (L1145-1147, L1172-1173), and the in-app gate refuses the write on any warning.
- Pinning tests and the tool_gate / thread_passes updates; conventional subject; `Fixes #4228`; `Changelog:` line; decision record present; no process files; no snapshot PNGs; no goldens changed.
- No silent wrong output found: every unsupported case names itself.

Where it was built: local worktree `cc-pr4299-review` (PR #4299, opened from fork JSwetz), trial-merged with origin/main (clean, no conflicts). Not on the self-hosted runner: the author is not a collaborator and the workflow refuses non-collaborator PRs (permission "read").

Tests (trial-merged tree, CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test tormach_post` - 5/5 pass
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test work_offset_index` - 9/9 pass
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test heidenhain_cycles` - 20/20 pass
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test script_tormach --test tormach_coolant --test tormach_no_a_word --test tormach_rotary_travel --test tormach_same_tool --test tormach_stop_tool --test tormach_traverse_clearance --test tap_feed_mill_posts --test explain_tormach --test probe_tormach` - all pass (49/49)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test thread_passes` - 5/5 pass
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test conformance` - 7/7 pass (incl. `every_builtin_posts_every_golden_byte_exact`)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test cutter_hand` - 5/7 pass; 2 FAILED (below)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test control_comp` - 8/9 pass; 1 FAILED (below)
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` - clean
- `cargo xtask gate light` - 6 steps, 0 failed (release, wall 16.2 min)
- No example catalog suites: the diff touches a post, not a post-encoding toolpath; no `example_catalog*` covers the tormach post.

Requested before merge
1. `crates/app/tests/cutter_hand.rs` - remove "Tormach PathPilot" from the `M3_ONLY` const (L27). Update the stale comment and assertion at L267-274 ("#1977: Haas reverses now (M4), so Tormach PathPilot is the M3-only post here" and the `gen_err.contains("Tormach PathPilot")`). The tool_gate change removed Tormach from M3_ONLY_POSTS, so the refusal sentence no longer names the post: the generic sentence ("a Drill operation does not ask the spindle to reverse (no M4)...") is what the new gate returns. Two tests fail: `creation_refuses_a_left_hand_cutter_by_name_on_every_m3_only_post` (L127) and `an_edit_to_left_hand_refuses_generation_and_post_until_the_operation_asks` (L274).
2. `crates/app/tests/control_comp.rs` - remove "tormach" from the refusal loop at L212 (tormach now supports control comp; the warnings list is empty) and update the module doc comment (L6-8), which still says "the lathe post, Heidenhain and Tormach refuse it by name". One test fails: `the_lathe_and_the_other_mill_posts_refuse_a_control_op_by_name_and_the_gate_blocks` (L209-218).
3. `docs/decisions/4228-tormach-g54-1-p-m4-g74.md` - the record says MAX_BOUND is raised "to 500" in two places (L8 and the "Cost to change later" paragraph); the code and the PR body say 1000. Fix both sentences to 1000.
4. `crates/post/src/machine/installation.rs` L151 - the doc comment still says "A whole number 1..=255."; the bound is MAX_BOUND (1000) and the refusal text uses `1..{bound}`. Fix the sentence.
5. `crates/post/tests/tormach_post.rs` (new top-level file) - add the one-line reason in the PR body for a new top-level test file (AGENTS.md "New tests join a directory suite"). The file is standalone because no tormach directory suite exists; that is fine, but the one-line reason is still owed.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- `assets/posts/tormach.cps` L1364: `isLeftTap` probes `LEFT_TAP`, `TappingDirection`, `CycleDirection` and `ThreadHand`. The engine never emits those properties (CycleType is "TAP"; the app emits MillSpindle reverse only for Thread ops). Only `spinRev` works. Dead code is harmless; the extra probes mislead a reader. Consider dropping it or adding a comment.
- Left-hand taps stay refused at the posting door by `crates/app/src/posting_family.rs` L36-44 (#1453: "no post currently declares a left-hand tapping cycle"). Through the app, the G74 capability is unreachable; `tormach_post.rs` exercises it at the engine level. A conscious decision is owed: lift #1453 for Tormach, or record that the post capability is engine-only. Note the PR body does not say this.
- The app stores a setup's pick in a `u8` (`crates/app/src/setup_offsets.rs` L31: MAX_SLOT=254), so the app cannot select offsets 255-500 even though the post expresses 1..=500. Post-level only; consider saying so in the PR body.
- Issue #4228 asks for "a golden test pins one". The pinning tests are engine-level unit tests in `tormach_post.rs`, not golden `.nc` files under `tests/golden/`. Recommendation: not a blocker, but the golden ask is unmet; the existing conformance goldens do not prove the new output.
- Compensation-cancel on a rapid (G0) between COMP-engage and the next G1: the pending cancel is dropped with a warning, and the app gate refuses the write. Same pattern as Fanuc (assets/posts/fanuc.cps L414-415, identical semantics). No silent output.
- G41.1/G42.1 from the issue are not implemented (wear-comp paths write the same G41/G42 + D and say so once). Not raised as a blocker; the Fanuc precedent does the same.
- The engine's MAX_BOUND raised to 1000 exceeds the app's own 254-slot storage and the post's 500 limit (a sanity bound). Consistent with "sanity bound"; noted only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a3a8a05b46a8531911a064596dba500ca94a08f4 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Re-review of the fix commit a3a8a05b4 (head a3a8a05). This is a SAFETY-tier change (posted G-code). I read the delta since e4a940b9a and the full diff at this head against current main. The trial merge with main is clean (no conflicts; one local "trial merge (local review only)" commit, never pushed). All three blocking items from the earlier review are fixed and verified with tests and mutation probes.

What looks good
- G17 is restored before the G41/G42/G40 block (compPlaneWord on onLinear; assets/posts/tormach.cps). comp_plane.rs pins it; dropping the plane word re-breaks that test.
- Non-XY arcs are refused by name while compensation is engaged (compPlaneRefuse in onCircular). Dropping the refusal re-breaks the comp_plane refusal test. The Tormach enforcement now mirrors fanuc.cps exactly (same compPlaneWord / compPlaneRefuse / compRefuse shape).
- G74 left-hand rigid tapping is refused by name per the Tormach PathPilot guidelines (isLeftTap branch in onCycle). Dropping the gate makes tormach_left_hand_tap_is_refused fail. The right-hand G84 path is unchanged.
- The capability contract is consistent: tormach leaves the refusal loops in comp.rs / wear_comp.rs / control_comp.rs / cutter_hand.rs and joins the wear note and comp_plane loops.

Results merged with main (local build; trial merge 65c1263f9; CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6)
- Build (camcraft-post, camcraft-app): ok
- camcraft-post: tormach_post 5/5, comp 9/9, comp_plane 3/3, work_offset_index 9/9
- camcraft-app: wear_comp 6/6, control_comp 9/9, cutter_hand 7/7, thread_passes 5/5
- Tormach-using example suites: first_4axis_part 4/4, continuous_4axis_part 10/10
- clippy (-p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings): clean
- light lane (cargo xtask gate light): 6 steps, all ok (motion lib, adaptive_troch_island, adaptive_troch_neck, adaptive_troch_parallel, app pocket_pass_start)

Targeted tests (step 5)
- No example_catalog case uses the Tormach post (verified: no "tormach"/"770MX" under examples/catalog); the Tormach-using example suites above ran and pass.
- Light lane: all 6 steps ok.
- P6 PR: no heavy step owed.
- The prior review's reference facts (175/177, two contract-failures) are superseded by the table above on the new head.

Requested before merge
- none.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Issue #4228's "Done means" asks for a left-hand tap to post G74. The PR refuses G74 by name instead (per the Tormach PathPilot post processor guidelines). The PR body and docs/decisions/4228-tormach-g54-1-p-m4-g74.md both document the change, but the issue text itself still asks for G74. Please confirm the refusal is the intended behaviour.
2. The app stores the WCS pick in a u8 (MAX_SLOT = 254, offset 1..=255) while the post now accepts up to 500. Offsets 256..500 are engine/post-side only; the app UI cannot select them. Please confirm this is intended or note it for a follow-up.
3. One minor edge: the left-hand-tap refusal and the machine right-hand-tap refusal share the tapRefused flag (one message per program). A right-hand tap after a left-hand one would be silently dropped rather than refused with a message.
4. Minor: a right-hand tap on a reverse-spindle (M4) section is refused with the "left-hand rigid tapping (G74)" message, which misnames the cause. The refusal is correct (G84 with M4 cuts the wrong hand); only the message is misleading.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
